title: 2.2.3 Haricot Bean (Phaseolus vulgaris L.)
description: Haricot bean: origin, cultivation, storage pests and harvesting

questions.question: What is the botanical name of haricot bean?
What is the other name of haricot bean?
Where did haricot bean originate?
For what purpose is haricot bean produced?
How are the immature pods of haricot bean used?
options: They are consumed as a vegetable
They are used as green manure
They are fed to livestock only
questions.correctAnswer: They are consumed as a vegetable

questions.question: What other use can haricot bean have besides human food?
options: It can be used for making fence posts
It can be used as fuel wood
It can be used as animal feed
It can be used for producing starch in industry
questions.correctAnswer: It can be used as animal feed

questions.question: In which soil types does haricot bean grow well?
options: Only sandy soils with no clay

questions.question: At what altitude does haricot bean grow well?
options: Between $1800$ and $3000$ m above sea level
Between $1400$ and $2000$ m above sea level
Between $2200$ and $3000$ m above sea level
Between $500$ and $1000$ m above sea level
questions.correctAnswer: Between $1400$ and $2000$ m above sea level

questions.question: How is haricot bean usually grown in Ethiopia?
options: Only as a mono crop away from cereals
Only grown together with faba bean
As a mono crop or mixed with cereals such as maize and sorghum
questions.correctAnswer: As a mono crop or mixed with cereals such as maize and sorghum

questions.question: With which crops is haricot bean grown in rotation?
Which seed colours can haricot bean seeds have?
What is the economic importance of haricot bean in Ethiopia?
options: It is an important export crop
It is used mainly as a cover crop
It is grown mainly for green manure
It is grown only for local consumption
questions.correctAnswer: It is an important export crop

questions.question: How can haricot bean be sown?
options: By scattering seed without any soil work at all times of year

questions.question: What row spacing is commonly used for haricot bean?
What plant spacing is commonly used for haricot bean in rows?
In intercropping, how are haricot bean rows arranged with maize or sorghum?
options: Haricot bean is planted between the plants of the cereal row at $40$ cm
Haricot bean rows are placed far away from the cereal rows
Haricot bean rows come between the rows of maize or sorghum, keeping $10$ cm between plants
Haricot bean is planted in the same row as maize at $10$ cm spacing
questions.correctAnswer: Haricot bean rows come between the rows of maize or sorghum, keeping $10$ cm between plants

questions.question: Which fertilizer is usually used for haricot bean production?
options: Mineral fertilizer applied at high rates

questions.question: What measures are recommended to control weed problems in haricot bean?
options: Wait until after harvest and then weed the field
Apply fertilizer to kill the weeds
Ensure a clean seedbed and carry out manual weeding within $4$ weeks of planting
Rely entirely on livestock grazing to remove weeds
questions.correctAnswer: Ensure a clean seedbed and carry out manual weeding within $4$ weeks of planting

questions.question: To which storage pests is haricot bean susceptible?
How are storage pests in haricot bean grain controlled?
options: Washing the grains and storing them wet
Storing the grains with the pods still green
Drying the grains until the moisture content is below $12$% and applying chemical treatment
Storing the grains in open sacks under direct sunlight
questions.correctAnswer: Drying the grains until the moisture content is below $12$% and applying chemical treatment

questions.question: How long does haricot bean take to mature?
What indicates that haricot bean is ready for harvest?
options: The leaves fall off and the pods turn yellow and start to dry
The seeds germinate inside the pod
The pods remain green and the leaves stay on the plant
questions.correctAnswer: The leaves fall off and the pods turn yellow and start to dry

questions.question: At what stage should haricot bean pods be harvested when the crop is produced for use as a vegetable?
options: When the pods are green and immature
After the leaves have all fallen off
After the seeds have become hard
After the pods have turned yellow and dried
questions.correctAnswer: When the pods are green and immature

questions.question: What is the national average yield of haricot bean in Ethiopia?
The national average haricot bean yield of $14$ quintals per hectare equals how many tonnes per hectare?
Why is haricot bean useful in a rotation with teff, maize or sorghum?
options: It improves soil fertility and helps the yield of the cereal crop
It removes all weeds from the cereal field
It shortens the growing period of the cereal crop
It keeps the soil permanently wet
questions.correctAnswer: It improves soil fertility and helps the yield of the cereal crop
